description: Price a dealer ticket from spot. Two classes: bullion (a tracked product) and scrap (weight + unit + karat or purity; purity is applied once). Buy offers use labeled default tiers as % of melt (bullion: conservative 96, target 97.5, aggressive 98.5; scrap: 90, 93, 95) or your own offer_pct; sell quotes use your margin rule: melt x (1 + margin_pct/100) + margin_usd. Returns unit and total (totals rounded once, from the unrounded unit), expiry, the spot used (spot_source, spot_asof), sell-side market percentiles and, for bullion buy offers, published dealer buyback bids as an anonymous benchmark (percentiles and counts only) when they exist. Never invents bids. Stateless.

class.description: bullion = a tracked coin or bar (default when product is given); scrap = metal by weight and karat or purity.

margin_pct.description: Margin rule: percent over melt (sell) or under melt (buy). Not combined with tier/offer_pct.

margin_usd.description: Flat USD per unit over melt (sell) or deducted (buy).

offer_pct.description: Your own buy offer as % of melt; overrides the tier default.

product.description: Tracked product slug from list_products (for example american-silver-eagle-1oz) or a name with its weight. A name only matches a product of the same weight.

purity.description: Scrap fineness as a fraction (use instead of karat; required for silver or platinum scrap).

quantity.description: Number of units (bullion) or identical scrap lots.

side.description: sell = you sell to a customer; buy = you buy from a customer. Default: buy for scrap or when tier/offer_pct is given, else sell.

spot.description: Optional spot price in USD per troy oz to use instead of Bullion Price Check's latest reading (gold-api.com). The answer labels it spot_source=caller.

spot_asof.description: Optional ISO time of the spot you passed in, echoed back as spot_asof.

tier.description: Buy offer default tier (% of melt). Buy quotes without tier, offer_pct or margins use target.

unit.description: Scrap weight unit: g = gram, dwt = pennyweight, ozt = troy ounce.

valid_seconds.description: How long the quote is good for; sets expires_at.

name: quote
title: Dealer buy/sell quote from spot
